stories.title: Seasonal Home Maintenance Tips Homeowners Forget
stories.description: Simple seasonal home maintenance areas homeowners often overlook throughout the year.

scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic time-lapse shot of a contemporary suburban home. The environment seamlessly transitions from autumn leaves to winter snow, then spring blooms, and bright summer sun. High dynamic range, hyper-realistic architectural photography style.
scenes.visual_reference: A suburban home shown across different seasons with subtle changes in weather and lighting.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, cartoon, blurry, distorted architecture
scenes.narration: Every season brings small changes that quietly affect how a home functions.

scenes.visual_prompt: Macro low-angle shot of a clean metal gutter overflowing during a heavy rainstorm. Detailed water droplets splashing, dark moody sky, wet shingles with realistic texture and reflections.
scenes.visual_reference: Rainwater flowing along a roof gutter during the rainy season.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, people, plastic look, dry spots
scenes.narration: During the rainy season, roof edges and gutters handle large amounts of flowing water.

scenes.visual_prompt: An outdoor HVAC condenser unit in a backyard. Intense golden hour sunlight creating a visible heat haze rising from the fan. Dry grass in the background, sharp focus on the metal grill of the unit.
scenes.visual_reference: An outdoor air conditioning unit exposed to strong summer sunlight.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, brand logos, indoor unit
scenes.narration: Hot summer temperatures place extra demand on cooling systems throughout the day.

scenes.visual_prompt: Interior close-up of a double-pane glass window. Condensation fogging the edges, small water beads trickling down. Through the glass, a blurry cold blue winter landscape is visible.
scenes.visual_reference: Light condensation forming on an indoor window during cold weather.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, frost indoors, broken glass
scenes.motion_hint: slow water bead sliding down glass
scenes.narration: In colder months, temperature differences can cause moisture to appear on windows.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of a wooden door frame meeting a brick wall. A visible hairline crack and gap in the caulking. Sharp textures of wood grain and mortar, neutral daylight.
scenes.visual_reference: Small gaps around a door frame and wall corner in a home.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, visible insects, dirty, messy
scenes.motion_hint: slow camera crawl along the crack
scenes.narration: Seasonal expansion and contraction can create small gaps around doors and walls.

scenes.visual_prompt: Professional shot of an open modern electrical panel. Tidy rows of circuit breakers with clear labels. Soft overhead garage lighting, shallow depth of field focusing on a 'Test' button.
scenes.visual_reference: A home electrical switchboard with clearly visible safety switches and organized wiring.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, exposed sparks, messy wires, fire
scenes.narration: Electrical systems also experience seasonal changes as usage patterns shift.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide angle interior of a cozy, minimalist living room. Warm ambient lighting from lamps, golden hour light hitting polished hardwood floors. A sense of peace and structural integrity.
scenes.visual_reference: A calm, clean, well-maintained home interior with balanced lighting.
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, clutter, dust, dark corners
scenes.narration: Paying attention to seasonal changes helps keep a home comfortable and well maintained year-round.
